signal.claim: Starbucks' 2026 US holiday TV spot "Perfect Harmony" is a 30-second hand-drawn animation from Anomaly and artist Geoff McFetridge, paired with a seven-track "Holiday Blend" album.
signal.quote: The 2026 spot, "Perfect Harmony," is a 30-second animation that McFetridge drew by hand on Starbucks cups using a Sharpie.

signal.claim: Starbucks said Starbucks Rewards reached a record 36 million 90-day active U.S. members on its Q4 FY2026 earnings call.
signal.quote: Starbucks Rewards Membership -- 36 million 90-day active members in the U.S., a record high representing sequential and year-over-year growth.

signal.claim: Starbucks became an Official Partner of Ligue 1 club Toulouse FC, with its logo on the sleeve of the men's first-team shirt and academy kits.
signal.quote: The US coffee chain became an Official Partner of Toulouse this morning, with its Siren logo taking the sleeve position on the men’s first-team shirt as well as the club’s academy kits.

signal.claim: Starbucks is running a travelling Bearista Holiday Experience pop-up in CapitaLand malls in Singapore, unlocked with a code in the CapitaStar app.
signal.quote: Key in the reward code BEARISTA on the CapitaStar app to unlock the pop-up experiences.

signal.claim: Starbucks launched its 2026 holiday menu, holiday cups, Bearista merchandise and a first-ever holiday pup cup nationwide on Nov. 5.
signal.quote: Starbucks' holiday menu items and new products debuted Nov. 5, with the chain's iconic holiday cups all dressed up in bows, garlands and trees.

signal.claim: Starbucks is launching a new line of Tiramisu Velvet drinks as part of its 2026 holiday menu.
signal.quote: Coffee lovers can also try a brand-new menu of tiramisu drinks inspired by the popular Italian dessert, including a Tiramisu Velvet Latte topped with a Velvet Mascarpone Cold Foam and cocoa powder

signal.claim: Starbucks and its licensee ZAMP announced a Brazil growth plan, including about 10 new coffeehouses by end of 2026 and two locations at Beto Carrero World in 2027.
signal.quote: In 2027, Starbucks plans to open two coffeehouse locations at Beto Carrero World – including one in the park's Cowboyland district
